_normalizations: English names merged from the english dataset BY BBS CODE (the bn/en lists are ordered differently and must never be merged by index).
Whitespace trimmed; English names title-cased (source mixes cases).

Chattagram -> Chattogram, Barisal -> Barishal (division + district) and Comilla -> Cumilla (district): official 2018 renames, matching the codebase canonical names; Coxsbazar -> Cox's Bazar and Coxsbazar Sadar -> Cox's Bazar Sadar (BBS spelling).
Bangla names normalized to Unicode NFC: upstream mixes composed/decomposed nukta forms (য় vs য+়); NFC gives one canonical form and matches the address parser's NFC-normalized input.

10 union nameEn collisions inside one upazila disambiguated from the Bangla name: 9 are municipalities (পৌরসভা -> " Municipality" suffix) and Natai (দক্ষিন)/(উত্তর) -> "(South)"/"(North)". No rows dropped.
Shayestaganj upazila (Habiganj, code 504) has 0 unions IN THE SOURCE — kept as an empty list, flagged here rather than filled by invention.
_knownIssues: Bhuapur Municipality (Bhuapur upazila, Tangail) appears TWICE in the source with codes 4543 and 4736 and near-identical Bangla spellings (ভুয়াপুর / ভুয়াপুর পৌরসভা) — apparently the same municipality listed twice upstream. Both rows are kept for fidelity; the seed upserts unions by (nameEn, upazila) so it is stored once.
